cool.root_cause: Agent failed to locate the apple because it did not explore all countertops and receptacles.
cool.evidence: After opening fridge, it returns to countertop1 and countertop2 but never goes to countertop3 or other locations where apple might be.
cool.corrective_rule: Systematically search all accessible receptacles (countertops, diningtable, etc.) before concluding object is absent.
cool.skill_tree_gap: Lack of systematic search strategy for target objects.

heat.root_cause: Agent failed to locate a mug as it visited only countertops and cabinets without finding one.
heat.evidence: At countertop3, it saw no mug; then opened cabinets but found only cup2 and soapbottle, not a mug.
heat.corrective_rule: Search all common mug locations (countertops, cabinets, diningtable) before proceeding.

pick_and_place.root_cause: Agent failed to find peppershaker after visiting countertops and cabinets, missing other locations like diningtable or fridge.
pick_and_place.evidence: After opening cabinet4, it stops; no peppershaker was ever observed.
pick_and_place.corrective_rule: If target object not on visible surfaces, search all other receptacles in the room.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: Agent took one candle but then stopped without placing it or searching for a second candle.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: Trajectory ends after 'take candle 2 from countertop 1'.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: After obtaining first target object, continue to place it and then search for the second.
